== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Moongrave serves as the capital city for the [[Akura clan]] and is situated at the heart of the [[Ashwind continent]]. The city is characterized by a dark, artistic aesthetic that resembles a paradise, featuring black-leafed trees and gardens filled with glowing blue, white, and pink flowers known as [[Moongrave amphelia]]. These plants thrive due to the abundant [[shadow aura]] present throughout the area, which is also noted for being thick and calming. The city's skyline includes dark towers and lanes of cloudships, while remnants and sacred birds often transport passengers via floating carriages. Moongrave is a significant location for training and safety, housing [[shadow aura]] cultivation rooms and various clan elders. It is also a site of immense power; the city is protected by defensive [[scripts]] and large spatial anchors, such as a massive tower used by [[Malice]] for transportation. However, the city is also a target of great importance; it has faced [[destruction]] from [[Dreadgod attacks]] and is considered a vital stronghold that, if lost, would significantly weaken the [[Monarch Malice]].}}

== Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Located closer to the west coast of the [[Blackflame Continent]] than previous destinations, Moongrave serves as a central setting for several key encounters. Within the heart of the location, [[Mercy]] resides in a cultivation room protected by a [[shadow aura]]. While visiting, [[Lindon]] experienced poor treatment from both [[Akura Douji|Douji]] and [[Akura Courage|Courage]]. The site is also where [[Charity]] was located, and it provided the setting for [[Akura Justice]] to examine [[Lindon]]'s [[spirit]].}}

== Bloodline ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-09-bloodline|Moongrave is a dark city characterized by its spires of smooth black [[stone]]. As a [[cloudship]] drifted over the location, it was revealed that [[Malice]] utilized a tower situated beneath the city to send people. The area possesses an [[aura]] that is notably rich and thick when compared to [[Sacred Valley]]. During these events, [[Lindon]] vanished from Moongrave.}}

== Dreadgod ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-11-dreadgod|Moongrave is a city located at the heart of the [[Ashwind continent]], characterized by cold winds, dark skies, and black walls similar to those of [[Shatterspine Castle]]. Connected to the Tower via a [[portal]], the city features defensive [[script-circle|script-circles]] worked into its foundation and a network of [[construct]] defenders. During a period of crisis, [[Charity]] ordered a retreat to the city, which includes a guest house and specialized dream [[scripts]]. The location faced immense peril when the [[Dreadgod]] focused its will upon it and the [[Silent King]]'s [[dream technique]] washed over the area, leaving the city in flames. As the [[Wandering Titan]] moved on a course toward the city, [[Lindon]], [[Yerin]], and [[Mercy]] arrived at Moongrave, where it served to provide support in keeping [[Lindon]] locked down.}}

== Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Moongrave is a location situated near the area where [[Reigan Shen]] returned. During the events of the story, [[Malice]] fled to this site, which was subsequently attacked by the [[Wandering Titan]]. [[Northstrider]] eventually returned to Moongrave, a place that is noted in connection with [[Serpent's Grave]]. The location remains a site that [[Lindon]] and [[Northstrider]] may visit again in the future.}}
